title: Phase 0: machine-readable contract artifacts
objective: Author spec/config.schema.json from §38, spec/control-api.openapi.yaml from §41, and spec/compat/jev-v1/openapi.snapshot.json from the frozen §6/§39 surface, so protocol behavior is reviewable as artifacts before implementation begins.
acceptance: config schema encodes C-CFG-001 through C-CFG-011 as machine-checkable rules
control OpenAPI encodes C-CTRL-001 through C-CTRL-011
jev snapshot records the frozen §6 surface without contacting the network
nonGoals: no network fetch of the upstream OpenAPI document
nextAction: Start FJ-003 (materialize the §44 golden vectors under testdata/contracts/).
notes: No JSON Schema instance validation was performed: no jsonschema implementation is available in this environment. The artifacts were checked structurally (parse, $ref resolution, required/properties agreement, cross-artifact agreement). Executing the schemas against instances is FJ-010's acceptance and FJ-046's harness.

spec/compat/jev-v1/openapi.snapshot.json is a reconstruction of the §6/§39 surface, not a capture of the upstream document. The file declares this itself (x-fake-jev.provenance = reconstructed-from-specification, networkFetch = false, plus a leading $comment). The §45 path name implies a capture, so the correction lives in the contents.

Five acceptance criteria are not expressible in JSON Schema and are named in the artifacts at the fields they govern, each with the reason: C-CFG-004 (alias normalization), C-CFG-005 (duplicate ids), C-CFG-009 (YAML/JSON equivalence), C-CFG-011 (precedence), and the criteria-dependent numeric cross-checks in C-JEV-013/C-JEV-015.

2026-09-26 incident: an initial FJ-002 commit swept in an unrelated modification to scripts/selftest because `git add -A` was used. The file is not this item's allowedFiles and the change is not mine and is not pure reformatting (import reordering, a removed "commit" string, dropped backslash continuations). The commit was rewritten to exclude it; the working-tree modification is preserved uncommitted pending a decision from the orchestrator. Future commits here use explicit paths, never `git add -A`.
